next_step: Finalize dedicated sizing + send pricing worksheet; schedule procurement kick-off (accounting + security)
notes: Discovery 2025-11-12: Product + infra - looking to add AI chat + improved search to flagship app; high quality, predictable cost is top priority.
Trial (hosted API) started 2025-12-01: engineering integrated SDK; used streaming + function-calls for rich responses.
Trial results (summary): avg QPS observed 6 req/s, daily peak 22 req/s during US morning; 95th pct concurrency spikes to 48 simultaneous streams on feature launch tests.

Token mix observed during trial: avg input 180 tokens, avg output 540 tokens -> ~720 tokens / request average; distribution ~60% chat, 30% embeddings (vector updates + re-rank), 10% reranking/batch scoring.
Cache behavior: prefix caching reduced repeated token churn ~12% in support flows but was disabled for personalized answers.
Latency targets: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 700ms for 512-token prompts; product team will accept slightly higher p99 during nightly batch scoring jobs.
Cost sensitivity: engineering/business goal effective cost < $0.003/token for majority chat workload; embeddings cost target <$0.10 per 1k vectors stored+queries amortized.
Initial interest: start with Hosted for prod-critical endpoints, then move hot paths to Dedicated for predictability and lower unit cost.
Dedicated sizing ask: provide capacity plan for sustained 150 QPS (6x current) and burst to 350 QPS for marketing-driven spikes; preserve p95 latency SLOs.

Redwood SE notes (2026-02-10): recommended baseline cluster 4 x A30-equivalent GPUs for steady-state + autoscale to 10 nodes for peak bursts; test FP16/INT8 quantization to reduce GPU memory and increase concurrency.

POC milestones: (1) infra provisioning + model variants (week 1), (2) perf tuning + KV cache on Dedicated (week 2-3), (3) canary traffic + compare cost per token (week 4), (4) security attestation + procurement (week 5-6).
Observed token volume baseline: projected current month token throughput extrapolated -> ~420M tokens/month; forecast growth path to ~2.1B tokens/month after 6 months of feature rollout.
Pricing conversation: asked for blended hosted-to-dedicated runway pricing and committed discount tiers; AE provided worksheet v1 (see drive link), awaiting internal finance review.
Customer quote from demo: 'We need predictable tail latency during peak support hours — anything that spikes our error budget is a hard no.'
Decision criteria: latency/p99, predictable monthly spend, ability to route by region, SSO + audit logs for compliance, easy model rollbacks.
Engineering notes: prefer model catalog entries for Llama 2-variant and small LLMs for embeddings; want automated fallback to smaller model under overload.
Security: privacy team requested documentation on KMS integration and retention controls; security FAQ link shared (drive).
Procurement cadence: legal/finance review window ~2-4 weeks after final pricing; security review can run in parallel but needs SOC2 artifact.
Next meeting scheduled: 2026-03-10 technical deep-dive (Omar + Infra lead) to finalize telemetry hooks and rollout plan.
Open items: finalize concurrency modeling for streaming responses, confirm GPU SKU options and sustained throughput numbers, sign-off on canary policy and rollback thresholds.
